note: Franky's notebook. Written by the duck itself (the model's weights never change). tries = attempts the note was shown in, wins = how many of those succeeded.

knowledge.text: The beak successfully picks up the banana when the middle is 0.00m from the beak tip and the long side is aligned (+87 degrees).
The vision model may fail to find the green box after the initial detection, returning "no box.
The task is incomplete if the green box cannot be visually located after picking up the banana.

skills.text: To pick up the banana, move until the distance is 0.00m and align the banana's long side with my direction.
If the green box is not found, keep searching for it until it is located or the command is explicitly finished.
